localBiteReport: The most recent available report (week of September 18–24, 2026) points to one of the better inshore stretches of the year around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay. Bait is now abundant and easy to find early in the morning, which is directly fueling strong action on redfish and flounder, with trout mixed in as well. Both bull reds and slot-sized redfish are biting well, especially on outgoing tides around bridges — croakers and spot minnows are the top live-bait choices for larger fish. Flounder are being caught as part of mixed-bag efforts alongside redfish, and the overall inshore picture, with water temperature at 86°F, reflects a classic early-fall transition kicking into gear across the area.
